scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && npm run config:generate && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run config:ci && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist-worker
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run config:generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:remote: npm run config:generate && wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run config:generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run ci && npm run doctor -- --remote && npm run db:migrations:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.types: npm run config:generate && wrangler types --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
